existing_review_owner: Original WORK/Review/Intake; no duplicate acceptance owner

rule_set.downstream: Transitive closure of original364 Unit edges, not entire Package barrier. Also list interface/source Consumer exposure separately.
rule_set.source_only: 191 DESIGN_CHECK_SOURCE rows remain source checks, not runtime Result dependencies or new owners.
rule_set.unreviewed_upstream: No formal consumer can satisfy an edge with author fixture/pending Result; exact Accepted Result+external acceptance or qualified scoped reuse required.
rule_set.failure: Failed/revised predecessor produces impact/revalidation candidates for original dependency descendants plus proven shared Contract consumers; does not erase historical Accepted receipts or auto-grant corrections.
rule_set.review_priority: Earliest unresolved shared prerequisite before its descendants; risk/impact priority among currently independent roots; group only compatible exact source/contract/environment/review scopes.
rule_set.minimal_revalidation: Source/Revision/Hash/DTO/Profile/Environment/Grant/Writer currentness; targeted trigger/negative tests and original mandatory tests; unrelated accepted results retained.
rule_set.preserve_stage: R1/R2/R3 review grouping does not cancel mandatory Unit, Wave-final or Human gates.
